name: Detroit Institute of Bagels
summary: Detroit Institute of Bagels (DIB) produces traditional scratch-made bagels using 24-hour cold fermentation, a classic boiling step, and stone-hearth baking. After a closure in 2020, the bakery reopened in 2023 at its current Grand River Avenue location. The shop closes early when daily batches sell out, so early arrival is recommended. DIB also offers specialty sandwiches and premium deli goods.
hoursNote: May close early when daily batches sell out. Monday is Baker's Rest.
